title: Transport properties of dissolved [O] in the (LiF–CaF2)eut.–NdOF molten salt system
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10691-10699
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08877H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kailei Sun, Linsheng Luo, Xu Wang
By controlling potential in the range of 3.75–4.25 V while constraining the temperature at 1250–1350 K, the O*(II) ion mobility of the saturated (LiF–CaF2)eut.–NdOF system can be maintained in the ideal range of 7.0 × 10−8 m2 V−1 s.
